name: 小糸
text: ひ、雛菜ちゃんどこでやるの……？
trans:
H-Hinana-chan, where are you going to do your 
drawing?

name: 雛菜
text: 絵を描くなら美術室でしょ～
trans:
If you are going to draw, 
it should be in the art room right～

name: 小糸
text:
今日は部活無いのかな
美術部……
trans: The art club probably doesn't have pratice today.

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
それならラッキーだね～

name: 雛菜
text:
じゃ、透先輩
そこの真ん中座って～
trans:
Alright, Toru-senpai
Sit right there in the middle

name: 小糸
text:
ほ、ほんとに透ちゃん
描くんだ……
trans: Y-You're really going to draw Toru-chan?

name: 雛菜
text:
そうだよ～
前にも言ったでしょ～？
trans: Yup, I told you before, didn't I?

name: 雛菜
text:
この間の美術の授業中、透先輩のクラスに行ったら
授業の邪魔だからだめって言われたけど～……
trans:
The other day during art class, when I went to 
Toru-senpai's class, the teacher told me no
because I was disturbing the lesson～

name: 雛菜
text:
どこでも好きな場所で描いていいって
言ったのにね～
trans:
Even thought the teacher said we could draw 
wherever we wanted～

name: 小糸
text: それは、そうかもしれないけど……！
trans: Well, that might be true but....!

name: 雛菜
trans: But, I was in class too～……

name: 雛菜
text:
ま、仕方ないから
今日大体どういう構図にするか描いて～
trans:
Well, it can't be helped.
So today I'll do a rough composition sketch and 
see how I want it to be～

name: 雛菜
text:
あとは写真撮って
それ見て授業中に描く～！
trans:
Then I'll take some photos
and I'll finish it during class.

name: 雛菜
text:
すっごい上手に描くから
楽しみにしてていいよ～？
trans:
I'm going to draw it really well so you can look 
forward to it okay～？

name: 透
text:
何描くの
美術のやつ
trans: What are you going to draw for art class?

name: 小糸
text: ま、まだ決められてなくて……

name: 円香
text:
呼び出すなら場所くらい書いて
返信も無いし
trans:
If you are going to call me out, at least text where to 
meet.
And you didn't reply either.

name: 円香
text:
………………
何してるの、そっちのふたり
trans:
......
What are you two doing over there?

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～？
透先輩描いてる～！
trans:
Eh～?
I'm drawing Toru-senpai right now～!

name: 小糸
text: わ、わたしも描きたいな……！

name: 小糸
text:
透ちゃんと円香ちゃんと
雛菜ちゃん！

name: 小糸
text:
ま、真似じゃないからね……
雛菜ちゃん……！
trans:
I-It's not because of I'm copying you okay?
Hinana-chan...!

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～
何も言ってないのに～！
trans:
Eh～?
But I didn't say anything yet～！
